_comment: Merge into the project's .claude/settings.json. Hooks call the same scripts as git hooks; mode is read from .kickstart/project.md.

hooks.command: sh -c 'cmd=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))"); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) sh .kickstart/hooks/kickstart-mode.sh secrets sh .kickstart/hooks/secret-scan.sh staged && sh .kickstart/hooks/kickstart-mode.sh env-files sh .kickstart/hooks/no-secret-files.sh $(git diff --cached --name-only) ;; *"git push"*) sh .kickstart/hooks/kickstart-mode.sh tests sh .kickstart/hooks/run-tests.sh ;; esac'

sh -c 'p=$(cat | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))"); sh .kickstart/hooks/kickstart-mode.sh env-files sh .kickstart/hooks/no-secret-files.sh "$p"'
